skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master vocabulary and terminology in the insurance industry.
Explain terms used in specific contexts related to social insurance and commercial insurance.
Understand legal documents related to insurance, comprehend the contents of insurance contracts, and analyze insurance proposals/reinsurance proposals.
Apply specialized English knowledge to draft insurance proposals/reinsurance proposals, transaction documents, and reports in the insurance field.
Fluently use specialized English in professional communication and insurance transactions.

Possess independent and team work capabilities, logical and critical thinking, proactive creativity, and adaptability to learning and working environments in an integrated context and application of technology.

Possess self-responsibility capability; understand and comply with national laws and organizational regulations, community service awareness, and recognition of business ethics and corporate social responsibility.
